about_the_game:
is a 2D exploration-adventure game with a dark yet healing atmosphere. Assume the role of a firefly to explore Tolampis, a mysterious forest shrouded in shadows. Immerse yourself in hand-painted watercolor visuals and soothing therapeutic music as you unravel the forest’s enigmatic puzzles and uncover its untold stories.

Key Features:

  • Explore while in flight: Search every nook and cranny for crucial clues and items to progress.

  • Encounter and interact with diverse insects and animals to unlock the unknown touching stories deep in the forest.

  • With a soothing music vibe, you can stay focused and savor every moment of the game.

  • Dual difficulty modes: Choose between "Relaxing Healing" for a laid-back experience or "Challenging Adventure" for a more thrilling quest.

  • Music-driven puzzles: Sound becomes an integral part of the gameplay, with musical elements central to solving mysteries.

  • Hand-painted watercolor art: Experience vivid, lifelike visuals that breathe magic into the game’s whimsical world.

Venture through the dark forest in pursuit of faint glimmers of light. Let the ethereal music and imaginative world guide you as you explore and uncover the tales hidden within.
